articles.title: Ruined: Mould Liquid
articles.summary: Dark olive-green mottled surface with fine speckle and faint pale scratch-like streaks. Reads as a dark murky olive with a pale mottled haze, like mould or crazed enamel; the web melts into grey-green speckle and the diagonal line is a single scratch.

Up close: Dark olive-black ground covered in a glowing web of thin pale cream-green lines, 1-2 px wide, forming a crazed network of tiny wobbly cells about 15-25 px across. One bright diagonal fault line runs from top-left to bottom-right across the tile, and faint diamond-shaped clusters show in the web. From a distance: Reads as a dark murky olive with a pale mottled haze, like mould or crazed enamel; the web melts into grey-green speckle and the diagonal line is a single scratch. Measured spec (average): metal 36, roughness 127, coat 123. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.

Almost nothing: the web already makes it busy; plates for numbers
Pairs well with: black, rust, brown.
pitfalls: Not faint scratch streaks: the old card says a mottled surface with faint scratches, the render is a dense glowing crack web with one diagonal fault
Not moss texture with soft blobs: lines are thin and hard-edged
Avoid: avoid pairing with another dark olive mottled texture, small numbers over busy mottle.
